Definition: something written, i.e. a writing, record or book
BiblicalUsage: 1) a writing, document, edict; 1a) register, enrolment, roll; 1b) mode of writing, character, letter; 1c) letter, document, a writing; 1d) a written edict; 1d1) of royal enactment; 1d2) of divine authority
